page.layout: One page: a single calendar table of five columns (Indict., An. Iul., Lit. dom., Nabon. Feriæ., Christi.), divided into three blocks by rules, with the Dec. entries in a column between the feriae and the Christi years. Running head at top, page number at top left. No margin notes. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. Feriæ. | | Christi.

page.notes: The Christi. year for Indict. 11 reads 1029 as printed, where the sequence expects 1028; likely a printing error, left as printed. The numeral 1031 is partly faint in the scan. Dec. entries are placed beside the row where the rule meets the column. Feriæ numbers are read directly from the table.
